question_text: Was the Docomo customer data leak a hack?
answer_text: Yes. Docomo says outside parties got into My docomo and its online shop, and that customer information leaked. Jiji Press and Nippon TV report the same. The cause and the attacker are not established.
label: Confirmed

answer_text: Names, birth dates, contact details, ID-document numbers and contract details for all affected customers, and bank account details for some. Docomo says My Number card information did not leak.
label: Confirmed

question_text: How did the attacker get in?
what_would_settle_it: Docomo publishing a full cause report, or a second source confirming the d-account automated-collection account.
Docomo, police or a credible researcher naming the party, or a verified claim of responsibility.

question_text: Is the Nov 5 network outage part of this?
answer_text: Docomo says no. It reports congestion at 5G SA switches and no sign of unauthorized access or a cyberattack in that outage.
label: Reported
